access_surface: Linux or Colab notebook (T4/L4) using the official Hunyuan3D-2 stack
prompt_guidance: Bias toward grounded historical proportions instead of dramatic concept-art silhouettes.
Keep prompts focused on one asset family per job so review can reject or accept quickly.
Ask for clean materials and hard-surface readability that survive Blender cleanup.
For larger scenes, describe one modular component per prompt (pillar, arch, wall segment) instead of an entire city.
When reference images exist, run a multi-view pre-pass (front/back/left/right/top/bottom) and feed Hunyuan3D-2-MV to avoid hallucinated backs.
provenance_notes: Capture the Colab notebook link or session note used for the run.
Record prompt, negative prompt, seed, and output filenames before publish.
Attach the Blender cleanup profile used after generation.
review_checklist: Silhouette reads as Roman equipment at gameplay distance.
Mesh can survive simple cleanup without heroic manual repair.
Export set includes GLB for review and FBX fallback for Flax-side intake.
If this is a modular piece, it snaps cleanly with other modules after cleanup.
setup_steps: Prefer a Linux or Colab runtime because the official stack is Linux-first.
Clone the official repository, install the pinned requirements, and use the official Gradio or API path instead of a random fork.
On free Colab (T4), start with Hunyuan3D-2 Mini or Turbo and pass --low_vram_mode to avoid OOM.
Use the full Hunyuan3D-2 model only on L4/A100-class GPUs when the Mini/Turbo output is not sufficient.
If you have multiple views, prefer the multi-view pipeline for cleaner geometry.
Optional: pre-clean references in ComfyUI (background removal + depth ControlNet) before the multi-view pass.
progression_steps: Start from one clean reference image or one narrow asset prompt, not a broad pack concept.
Reject bad silhouette or proportion results before you spend time on texture or Blender cleanup.
Promote only the strongest mesh into Blender cleanup, then export GLB first and FBX as fallback.
For city-scale needs, generate a small kit of modular pieces and assemble the scene in Blender or Flax.
If runtime slows down, switch to hunyuan3d-dit-v2-mini-turbo for fast iterations, then rerun the best prompt on full model when GPU budget allows.
Bake textures or vertex colors to PBR maps in Blender after Quadriflow remesh; keep the bake and cleanup noted in provenance.
runbook: Generate 2-3 variants, reject weak silhouettes early, and only clean the strongest pass.
Run Blender MCP normalization before any reviewed payload is copied into publish/flax_intake.
Keep rejected generations out of the final payload folder.
Full-scene generation (HunyuanWorld) is Pro-only; free-tier workflows should stay modular.
For multi-view, use Zero123++ or SyncDreamer to create consistent 6-view renders, then feed Hunyuan3D-2-MV.
Post-process in ComfyUI-Hunyuan3D wrapper if masking or remeshing is needed before Blender cleanup.
